blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – About 40,000 employees of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) are eagerly awaiting the release of their year-end bonus, one month’s basic pay plus a P5,000 cash gift, their first under the first elected regular parliament. Minister Ubaida Pacasem of the Ministry of Finance and the Budget and Management (MFBM-BARMM) said his office has already released the P1.8 billion for BARMM workers’ year-end bonuses. “Reminding ministries, offices, and agencies across the region to ensure the timely release of the one-month basic salary and P5,000 cash gift, simultaneous with the first payroll of November,” Pacasem said in […]...
